source_pool: Exactly10 current training recordings absent from original B0 train split. No old B0 in-sample predictions used to fit S2.
selection: Per outer fold:6 inner-fit/2 inner-select choose NLL epoch including identity0; refit8 for fixed chosen epochs; evaluate untouched outer2. Final10 fit for integer median of five nested-selected epochs. Development8 never used to select epochs or thresholds.
fixed_epoch_rule: Floor of median; no parameter search; train-only normalization independently fitted in each fit/refit
evaluation: Same Future1.5s,2Hz,.5/K2,exact from/to one-to-one [b-1.5,b); no backdating. Current and Prompt unchanged.
gate: OOF AND development three-seed mean recall strictly improves with no increase in mean false/min; no seed may lose hits or increase false count; at least two seeds improve hits. No automatic promotion even if passed: independent new recordings required.
limits: 10 source recordings already exposed to other past experiments; OOF is strict for current frozen-B0 plus S2 estimator, but not a new independent blind test or unbiased comparison across historical model selection.
S3: Deferred unless P1 and OOF establish consistent benefit; no oracle stage/remaining-time inputs. No large networks or B0 retraining.
